description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2025: Surrogate-Aided Bayesian Calibration on Finite Element Model of Reinforced Concrete Bridge Column is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Cyrus Rohrbough, Cooper Union for Advancement of Science and Art (cooper.edu). This project is uses a surrogate-aided Bayesian calibration algorithm to calibrate a model of a reinforce concrete bridge column subjected to three earthquakes sequentially. This project utilizes a surrogate-aided Bayesian calibration algorithm which makes it possible to perform Bayesian calibration on finite element models with longer evaluation times. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fhem-g324. Keywords: NSF NHERI Computational Modeling and Simulation Center (SimCenter), Earthquake Engineering,  Bayesian Calibration, Surrogate-Aided Bayesian Calibration, FEM. Published 2025-08-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
